description: This file defines the FavoritesController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling HTTP requests related to favoriting and unfavoriting articles. It uses dependency injection for IMediator and includes endpoints secured with authorization schemes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing favorite articles with endpoints to add or remove favorites, secured via JWT authentication.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add an article to favorites, using article slug and mediating the command.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites, using article slug and mediating the command.
